s1.desc: a living room with a cream couch and a glass coffee table, drawn on a plain pale grey background

s2.desc: a bathroom vanity with a basin sink and a mirror, drawn on a plain pale grey background

s3.desc: a bathroom with a white toilet and a toilet paper holder on a plain pale grey wall above a teal tiled floor

spans.view: with a throw pillow on the couch and the coffee table in the foreground

beats.text: Pax lounges on his back across the couch, looking up at {ifin}
Pax rolls up to sit on the couch, knocking the throw pillow crooked
Pax hops down off the couch and lands on the floor with his fins spread
Pax steadies himself with his fins out and his eyes closed
Pax turns a little to the left and looks down at {ifin} in his fin

spans.notes: phone checked at full resolution (f2, f45): pale grey back, three-lens cluster, little tuft on top = iFin
pillow insert: only Polly's fins reach in to fluff and chop the pillow; sparkles at the end

spans.view: with a hand towel hanging from a rail under the counter

beats.text: Pax stands at the vanity and rubs his fins dry on the hand towel hanging from the rail, rumpling it
Pax lets go of the crooked towel, turns and waddles a few steps to the right

spans.notes: keep12 dips at the end only because the cut at f150 falls inside the 12-frame look-ahead; compare 105/149 locked
towel insert: only Polly's fins straighten the towel; sparkles

spans.view: with a towel on a rail behind the toilet

beats.text: Pax sits on the toilet with his eyes fixed on {ifin}
Pax reaches back and yanks a long strip of toilet paper off the roll without looking up from {ifin}
Pax pulls even more paper loose in big loops that pile over his lap and onto the floor
Pax keeps his eyes on the phone while a long strip of paper hangs from the roll to the floor

spans.notes: phone checked at full resolution (f210): iFin
toilet paper roll insert: only Polly's fins roll the paper back and fold a paper dove; sparkles
fast zoom out from the roll to Polly and Pax in the bathroom
